tasks.title: Fix the score

hints.other: C# joins from left to right, so it glues on 3 and then 4. Put brackets round the sum, (homework + test), or use $"Your score is {homework + test}".
hints.spaces: There is already a space at the end of "Your score is ". Don't add another.

hints.compile: C# doesn't know how to join the text and name. Put a + between them.
hints.spaces: There is already a space after the comma inside the speech marks. Don't add another.

tasks.title: Favourite things

tests.output:
You like pizza
Your favourite animal is cats

You like chips
Your favourite animal is dogs

hints.lines: You need a second Console.WriteLine() for the animal: Your favourite animal is cats.
hints.spaces: Type the sentence exactly, with one space between each word, and nothing after {animal}.
hints.other: Did you put $ before the speech marks and the variable in braces, {animal}? Without the $ C# prints the braces.
hints.compile: Check the line ends with ); and that every { has a }.
